The Amazon Black Friday Sale is well under way, with a highlight of picks for you down below, while the massive majority of deals we couldn’t fit here being in our Black Friday Green Deals hub . We’ve got a collection of lows here, starting with Worx’s 40V 20-inch Cordless Snow Blower + 2x batteries at a new $350 low . Then there’s the new and exclusive lows on Anker’s SOLIX E10 Whole-Home Backup System starting from $3,609 – plus, FREE gifts, too. You’ll find Velotric’s Breeze 1 Cruiser e-bike with a FREE $640 bundle (including an extra battery) for $1,699 , giving it a 140-mile travel range, as well as Eve’s Aqua HomeKit Smart Water Controller at $100 , the EGO Power+ Nexus Escape 400W Portable Inverter at $129 , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Worx’s 40V 20-inch Cordless PowerShare snow blower + 2x batteries just hit a new $350 low for Black Friday
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday Sale , you can currently score the best price on Worx’s 40V 20-inch Cordless Snow Blower with 2x 20V 6.0Ah batteries down at $349.99 shipped . This is a more affordable snow clearing solution from Worx that has a $420 full price. We’ve previously seen discounts cut things down as low as $357 during October’s Prime Day event, but you’re getting an even bigger deal during this savings event. You’re looking at a $70 markdown for a new all-time low price. You can also find a massive list of Worx’s tool deals during this sale here .
Get whole-home backup support from Anker’s SOLIX E10 system starting from an exclusive new $3,609 low
Alongside both Amazon’s Black Friday event , and the Anker SOLIX Black Friday power station sale , you can also find new low prices during the brand’s E10 Whole-Home Backup System Sale . Things for this system start standard 6kWh base setup of a module and battery at $3,609.05 shipped , after using the code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, beating out Amazon by $190 . Down from $4,299, we previously saw discounts – with the exclusive bonus savings – only going as low as $3,799. Now though, with the initial discount cutting things down to that rate, you’re getting even more savings ($690 total savings) using the code, marking a new all-time low price. Head below to check out the top picks, or browse the full lineup of deals here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
***Note: We haven’t included any of the exclusive bonus savings into the prices you see below, so be sure to use our code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout for the absolute best prices during this sale.
Top picks from the Anker SOLIX Black Friday E10 lineup:
E10 standard system (6kWh) with 1x power module and 1x battery: $3,799 (Reg. $4,299)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module and 2x batteries: $5,799 (Reg. $6,299)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, and a Smart Inlet Box: $6,099 (Reg. $6,599)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, and Power Dock: $7,299 (Reg. $7,799)
E10 system (12kWh) with 1x module, 2x batteries, Power Dock, and Smart Generator 5,500: $9,798 (Reg. $10,098)
And more…
Velotric’s Breeze 1 e-bike cruises up to 140 miles with an included extra battery + $220 of other FREE gear – all at $1,699
As part of Velotric’s expanded Black Friday e-bike sale , you can currently find the biggest deal to date on the Breeze 1 Cruiser e-bike with a FREE $640 bundle (including an extra battery) for $1,699 shipped . Down from $1,799, it’s rare to see anything but bundled items with this model, and when discounts do appear its down to this same rate, except for the one-time fall to $1,649 that occurred back in February. As I stated, this is the biggest bundle deal we’ve tracked for this model, which includes a rear cargo rack, fender set, rear pannier bag, and an extra battery for double the mileage. You can learn all about it below, or shop the full sale lineup here .
Add Eve’s Aqua HomeKit smart water controller to spigots this Black Friday at a $100 2026 low ($50 off)
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday Sale , you can upgrade your spigot with the Eve Aqua HomeKit Smart Water Controller down at $99.95 shipped . Down from $150, we’ve seen discounts take things as low as $110 before this seasonal event. Now though, you’re able to score one with a $50 markdown, landing it at the best price of the year, which only sits $1 above the all-time low. You can find various other Eve smart devices here .
Build your own power station with EGO batteries you already have: 400W Nexus Escape hits $129 ($40 off)
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday savings event , you can currently find the EGO Power+ Nexus Escape 400W Portable Inverter down at $129 shipped . Down from $169, we only saw one previous fall to this rate back in August, while October’s Prime Day event saw it dip a little lower to $123. The deal here is a solid $40 markdown, giving you the second-best price of the year that is only $6 above the annual low. You can shop more EGO deals in the official Amazon storefront here .
Black Friday 2026 Green Deals Hub: e-bikes, EVs, power stations, tools, appliances, and more
